content: 1 Prayse ye the Lorde. Prayse God ye seruauntes: prayse ye the name of God. 2 Blessed be the name of God: from this time foorth for euermore. 3 The name of God is to be praysed: from the rising vp of the sunne, vnto the goyng downe of the same. 4 God is high aboue all Heathen: and his glory aboue the heauens. 5 Who is like vnto God our Lord that dwelleth on hygh aboue all: 6 and yet humbleth him selfe to beholde the thinges that are in heauen and in earth? 7 He rayseth vp the simple out of the dust: and lyfteth vp the poore from the dounghyll. 8 For to make him sit with the princes: euen with the princes of his people. 9 He maketh the barren woman to kepe house: and to be a ioyful mother of children. Prayse ye the Lorde.
